evidence: forms/c089.json, sample_overlap.shares_participants_with: Possible overlap with c471: Liu, Li, Zuo, Lu, and Feng (2026), Exploring the impact of ChatGPT on college students' mathematical creativity: A quasi-experimental study, doi:10.14742/ajet.10564. The c089 ChatGPT arm and c471 experimental arm have identical reported demographics: age M = 19.20, SD = 1.36; male/female 39/21; sciences/liberal arts/engineering 16/16/28; prior ChatGPT experience never/seldom/sometimes/often/always 2/10/24/23/1. They also use the same baseline and four MCT tasks, but their creativity means and SDs differ. Neither full text explicitly confirms shared participants or independence. Reuse and the number of shared people remain unconfirmed; author clarification is needed before treating these samples as independent. Possible overlap does not establish that c089 is a reanalysis.
